note: Perry County (IN) publishes no queryable zoning district service. Unincorporated zone maps (Chapter 153, 153.025) are adopted per township and kept on file at the County Plan Commission office; no digital service is linked. Tell City's zoning map is a static 2014 PDF. The Cannelton and Troy zoning maps are not online as services; the Indiana 15 RPC site has base maps only. The county GIS viewer (perryin.wthgis.com) is parcel-oriented and exposes no ArcGIS REST endpoint (its /arcgis/rest/services returns 404), and no zoning layer was found in ArcGIS Online or Hub searches for the county.
